Changelog:
v1.0.4.19 - Targeting loop during Pyretic finally fixed. Pyretic damage was already blocked in v1.0.4.17 but Gluttony autorotation kept running because the hardcoded NoActStatus ID list (960 / 1387 / 2127) missed the actual Pyretic variant in the latest dungeon. Run() kept swapping targets, AutoDuty cleared them, Run() swapped back - the fight Joey described.

Replaced NoActStatus with Wrath upstreams PlayerHasActionPenalty at both gates (ShouldSkipAutorotation and UseActionDetour). PlayerHasActionPenalty builds the Pyretic lookup dynamically from Luminas status sheet by icon (215647) plus encounter-specific IDs plus Acceleration Bomb expiry-timing - same detection Wrath has shipped for months. Catches every Pyretic variant in every encounter without us having to maintain a hardcoded list.

Also cleaned up the duplicate "using GluttonyCombo.Data;" lines that the v1.0.4.17 patch script accidentally inserted ~25 times in AutoRotationController.cs (compiled fine but ugly).

Deleted Data/NoActStatus.cs - superseded by PlayerHasActionPenalty.
